image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a single car wheel mounted on a vehicle. The wheel features a polished chrome alloy rim with five Y-shaped spokes radiating from a central hub cap. A black rubber tire surrounds the rim, showing visible tread patterns and sidewall texture. The background includes a small portion of the yellow vehicle body at the top and a concrete surface at the bottom.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of wheel (alloy/chrome) and ensure no misclassification as similar circular objects.
To verify the boundary between the metal rim and rubber tire is sharp and free of melting or bleeding artifacts common in AI generation.
To ensure the depth relationships between the spokes, hub cap, and rim barrel are physically consistent and not flattened or warped.
To analyze the complex reflections on the chrome surface for logical consistency with the environment (ground/car body).

focus_areas: Physical plausibility of the hub cap
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the reflections on the chrome rim. In AI images, reflections often smear or fail to match the surrounding environment (the yellow car body and grey ground). Verify if the reflections are coherent. Also, check the symmetry of the spokes; AI often generates slightly asymmetrical or warped spoke widths.
